abstract: Public financing of major league sports venues has been widely studied, but government support for minor league facilities has not been systematically documented. This study introduces a new database of Minor League Baseball stadium funding to measure the prevalence and magnitude of subsidies. State and local governments have spent $7 billion constructing and renovating 134 minor league ballparks for Major League Baseball (MLB) affiliates, raising important policy implications for moderately sized municipalities. Using MLB's reorganization of its minor leagues as a natural experiment, the analysis finds no income differences between cities that lost or retained teams, undermining the economic rationale for taxpayer subsidization.
abstract_zh: 职业大联盟体育场馆的公共融资问题已被广泛研究，但政府对小联盟设施的支持尚未得到系统记录。本研究引入了一个新的小联盟棒球场融资数据库，以衡量补贴的普遍性和规模。州及地方政府已为美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）附属球队的134个小联盟球场建设与翻新投入了70亿美元，这对中等规模城市产生了重要的政策启示。利用MLB对小联盟的重组作为自然实验，分析发现失去或保留球队的城市之间并无收入差异，这削弱了纳税人补贴的经济合理性。
title: The public cost of Minor League Baseball stadium subsidies
title_zh: 小联盟棒球场补贴的公共成本

abstract: We study optimal service allocation through queues when agents have homogeneous preferences and must be incentivized to enter and remain in the queue. The designer controls entry, exit, service priority, and information about queue priorities. Under a mild regularity condition, the optimal mechanism admits agents only up to a cutoff queue length, never removes admitted agents, serves them according to a first-come, first-served (FCFS) rule, and provides no information beyond recommendations. FCFS is also necessary for optimality in a rich domain. The result identifies a new role for queue disciplines in regulating agents’ beliefs and dynamic incentives, and uncovers a hitherto unrecognized virtue of FCFS in this regard.
title: Optimal Queue Design

abstract: Big Boss Games represent a specific class of cooperative games where a single veto player, known as the Big Boss, plays a central role in determining resource allocation and maintaining coalition stability. In this paper, we introduce a novel allocation scheme for Big Boss games, based on two classical solution concepts: the Shapley value and the \(\tau \)-value. This scheme generates a coalitionally stable allocation that effectively accounts for the contributions of weaker players. Specifically, we consider a diagonal of the core that includes the Big Boss’s maximum aspirations, the \(\tau \)-value, and those of the weaker players. From these allocations, we select the one that is closest to the Shapley value, referred to as the Projected Shapley Value allocation (PSV allocation). Through our analysis, we identify a new property of Big Boss games, particularly the relationship between the allocation discrepancies assigned by the \(\tau \)-value and the Shapley value, with a particular focus on the Big Boss and the other players. Additionally, we provide a new characterization of convexity within this context. Finally, we conduct a statistical analysis to assess the position of the PSV allocation within the core, especially in cases where computing the Shapley value is computationally challenging. abstract_zh: 大老板博弈是一类特殊的合作博弈，其中被称为"大老板"的单一否决权玩家在决定资源分配和维护联盟稳定性方面发挥着核心作用。本文基于两个经典解概念——沙普利值和τ值——为大老板博弈提出了一种新的分配方案。该方案能够产生联盟稳定的分配结果，有效体现弱势玩家的贡献。具体而言，我们考虑核心的对角线，该对角线包含大老板的最大期望值、τ值以及弱势玩家的期望值。从这些分配方案中，我们选取最接近沙普利值的分配方案，称为投影沙普利值分配（PSV分配）。通过分析，我们发现了大老板博弈的一个新性质，特别是τ值与沙普利值所分配的差异之间的关系，重点关注大老板与其他玩家之间的差异。此外，我们还在该背景下给出了凸性的新刻画。最后，我们通过统计分析评估PSV分配在核心中的位置，特别是在计算沙普利值存在计算困难的情况下。
title: The Shapley value and the strength of weak players in big boss games
title_zh: 大老板博弈中的沙普利值与弱参与者力量

abstract: Abstract Characterizing and explicitly computing equilibria of undiscounted dynamic games have been a challenge for many years. In this paper, we study quitting games , which are stopping games where the terminal payoff does not depend on the stage of termination. We adapt the recursive approach of Abreu et al. (Econometrica 58(5):1041–1063, 1990) to characterize a certain subset of the set of subgame-perfect $$\varepsilon $$ -equilibrium payoffs. Our approach is based on the novel representation of strategy profiles through absorption paths , which was developed in Ashkenazi-Golan et al. (Math Program 203(1–2):735–762, 2024), and our characterization focuses on absorption paths in which exactly one player randomizes between quitting and continuing at any point in time. Since quitting games form a special case of both stopping games and stochastic games, our approach may be useful in studying more general classes of these games.
abstract_zh: 摘要 多年来，对未折现动态博弈的均衡进行刻画并显式计算一直是一个挑战。本文研究退出博弈，即终止支付不依赖于终止阶段的停止博弈。我们借鉴Abreu等人（《计量经济学》58(5):1041–1063, 1990）的递归方法，刻画了子博弈完美ε-均衡支付集合中的某一特定子集。我们的方法基于通过吸收路径对策略组合的新颖表示，该表示由Ashkenazi-Golan等人（《数学规划》203(1–2):735–762, 2024）提出，并且我们的刻画聚焦于在任意时间点恰好有一名玩家在退出与继续之间随机化的吸收路径。由于退出博弈既是停止博弈又是随机博弈的特例，我们的方法可能有助于研究这些博弈的更一般类别。
title: The APS approach for undiscounted quitting games
title_zh: 无贴现退出博弈的APS方法

abstract: We consider estimation and inference for a regression coefficient in panels with interactive fixed effects (i.e., with a factor structure). We demonstrate that existing estimators and confidence intervals (CIs) can be heavily biased and size-distorted when some of the factors are weak. We propose estimators with improved rates of convergence and bias-aware CIs that remain valid uniformly, regardless of factor strength. Our approach applies the theory of minimax linear estimation to form a debiased estimate, using a nuclear norm bound on the error of an initial estimate of the interactive fixed effects. Our resulting bias-aware CIs take into account the remaining bias caused by weak factors. Monte Carlo experiments show substantial improvements over conventional methods when factors are weak, with minimal costs to estimation accuracy when factors are strong.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了具有交互固定效应（即因子结构）的面板数据中回归系数的估计与推断问题。我们证明，当部分因子较弱时，现有估计量和置信区间可能存在严重偏误和尺寸扭曲。为此，我们提出具有更优收敛速度的估计量，以及无论因子强度如何均能保持均匀有效性的偏误感知置信区间。该方法运用极小化极大线性估计理论，通过对交互固定效应初始估计误差的核范数约束构建去偏估计量。由此得到的偏误感知置信区间能够充分考虑弱因子导致的剩余偏误。蒙特卡洛实验表明，在因子较弱时，该方法较传统方法有显著改进，而在因子较强时对估计精度的影响极小。
title: Robust Estimation and Inference in Panels with Interactive Fixed Effects
title_zh: 交互固定效应面板数据的稳健估计与推断

abstract: We develop an asset demand system to analyze the equilibrium relation between international portfolio holdings and flows, exchange rates, and asset prices across all countries. We introduce a nested logit model of asset demand, for which we develop a new identification strategy by instrumental variables. Averaged across years and issuer countries, the demand elasticities are 27.9 for short-term debt, 3.2 for long-term debt, and 1.2 for equity. These demand elasticities are empirical targets for international macro models that feature inelastic demand to resolve long-standing puzzles in international finance. We use the estimated demand system to decompose the variation in exchange rates and asset prices into portfolio flows and shifts in asset demand to interpret economic events such as the European sovereign debt crisis and to estimate the convenience yields on US assets. In units of annual expected returns, the convenience yield is 1.41% on the US dollar, 2.71% on US long-term debt, and 0.50% on US equity.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个资产需求系统，用以分析全球各国国际投资组合持有量、资金流动、汇率及资产价格之间的均衡关系。我们引入了一个嵌套逻辑模型来描述资产需求，并为此开发了一种新的工具变量识别策略。按年份和发行国平均计算，需求弹性分别为：短期债务27.9，长期债务3.2，以及股票1.2。这些需求弹性为国际宏观模型中应对需求缺乏弹性的情况提供了实证基准，有助于解决国际金融领域长期存在的难题。我们利用估计出的需求系统，将汇率和资产价格的变动分解为投资组合流动和资产需求变化，以解读欧洲主权债务危机等经济事件，并估算美国资产的便利收益。以年化预期收益为单位，美元的便利收益为1.41%，美国长期债务为2.71%，美国股票为0.50%。
title: Exchange Rates and Asset Prices in a Global Demand System
title_zh: 全球需求体系中的汇率与资产价格

abstract: In their response to Zeng (2026), Gaigné and Larue (2025) present two new results demonstrating the potential necessity of quality regulations based on their CES model. This brief note provides additional commentary on their findings.
abstract_zh: 在对Zeng（2026）的回应中，Gaigné和Larue（2025）基于其CES模型提出了两项新结果，展示了质量监管可能存在的必要性。本简短说明对其发现进行了补充评论。
title: A rejoinder to “Quality standards, industry structure, and welfare in a global economy”
title_zh: 对《质量标准、产业结构与全球经济中的福利》一文的回应

abstract: Dao-Zhi Zeng's comment identifies an important and potentially confusing ambiguity in Gaigné and Larue on the impact of quality regulations on welfare. In this reply, we clarify the effects of minimum quality standards on welfare under market imperfections and international trade.
abstract_zh: 曾道智的评论指出了盖涅与拉吕关于质量规制对福利影响中一个重要且可能引起混淆的模糊之处。在此回复中，我们澄清了在市场不完善和国际贸易条件下，最低质量标准对福利的影响。
title: A reply to “Quality standards, industry structure, and welfare in a global economy”
title_zh: 对《质量标准、产业结构与全球经济中的福利》一文的回应

abstract: Gaigné and Larue (American Journal of Agricultural Economics 98:1432–1449) examined the welfare implications of quality regulations within an international trade context, employing a general-equilibrium framework. Their study uses a CES (Constant Elasticity of Substitution) model and finds that stricter public standards might improve welfare. However, this conclusion was actually derived from a partial-equilibrium analysis. This note conducts a thorough general-equilibrium analysis and demonstrates that their anticipated outcome does not hold within their CES framework.
abstract_zh: Gaigné和Larue（《美国农业经济学杂志》98:1432–1449）在国际贸易背景下考察了质量规制的福利影响，采用了一般均衡框架。他们的研究使用CES（恒定替代弹性）模型，并发现更严格的公共标准可能改善福利。然而，这一结论实际上源自于局部均衡分析。本文进行了全面的一般均衡分析，并证明在其CES框架内，他们预期的结果并不成立。
title: A comment on “Quality standards, industry structure, and welfare in a global economy”
title_zh: 对《质量标准、产业结构与全球经济中的福利》一文的评论

abstract: We develop a spatially-explicit model of the U.S. beef packing industry to study key questions related to competition in an oligopsony setting. Cattle supplies are modeled at the county level, and packing plants' location, capacity, and ownership are taken as given. Packers procure negotiated cattle by competing in prices in each local (county) market, while accounting for transportation costs and pre-existing contracted supplies (alternative marketing arrangements). The model, calibrated to match observed 2022 data, is solved for the Bertrand–Nash equilibrium prices. The computed markdown in the price packers pay for fed cattle is decomposed into three components: the portion due to the inherent spatial oligopsony power; the amount due to an aspect of market concentration (firms owning multiple plants); and the component due to contracting. We find that markdowns are moderate, about $3.69/cwt or 2.6% of the fed cattle price, on average. About 54% of this markdown is due to the spatial configuration of plants, 40% is due to pre-contracted supplies, and only 6% of the markdown is attributed to multi-plant ownership by firms. Separately from markdowns, capacity constraints are found to lower fed cattle prices by 0.8% on average. Beyond the baseline, simulated counterfactual scenarios highlight specific policy-relevant questions. Markdowns are reasonably robust across counterfactuals, decreasing only modestly when plants operate independently or the use of contracting is limited. Across all counterfactual scenarios, cattle prices per se are most affected by tightening capacity constraints (as arising from a major plant closure or an upward swing in the cattle cycle).
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个空间显式模型，用以研究美国牛肉加工行业在寡头买方垄断情境下的关键竞争问题。牛只供应量在县级层面进行建模，而加工厂的选址、产能及所有权被视为既定条件。加工商通过在各地方（县级）市场中竞争价格来采购协议牛，同时考虑运输成本及预先存在的合同供应（替代营销安排）。该模型经过校准以匹配2022年的观测数据，并求解伯特兰-纳什均衡价格。我们将加工商为育肥牛支付的价格中的计算加价折扣分解为三个组成部分：固有空间寡头买方垄断势力所致的部分；市场集中度（企业拥有多家工厂）所致的部分；以及合同安排所致的部分。研究发现，加价折扣幅度适中，平均约为每英担3.69美元，占育肥牛价格的2.6%。其中，约54%的加价折扣源于工厂的空间布局，40%源于预先合同供应，仅6%归因于企业的多工厂所有权。与加价折扣相独立，产能约束平均使育肥牛价格下降0.8%。在基准情形之外，模拟的反事实情景凸显了特定政策相关问题。加价折扣在各反事实情景中保持相对稳健，仅在工厂独立运营或合同使用受限时略有下降。在所有反事实情景中，牛只价格本身受产能约束收紧的影响最大（如因大型工厂关闭或牛周期上行所致）。
title: Spatial price competition and buyer power in the U.S. beef packing industry
title_zh: 美国牛肉包装行业的空间价格竞争与买方势力

We thank Prof. Moriah Bostian (Department of Economics, Lewis and Clark College), Prof. Scott Irwin (Department of Agricultural and Consumer Economics, University of Illinois), Prof. Erik Lichtenberg (Department of Agricultural and Resource Economics, University of Maryland), and Dr. Maria Vrachioli (Agricultural Production and Resource Economics, Technical University of Munich) for their valuable comments. We acknowledge support from the Office for Futures and Options Research (OFOR) at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. We are grateful to the editor, Dr. Christian Langpap, and three anonymous reviewers for their constructive feedback that strengthened this manuscript. Earlier versions of this paper were presented at the ACE Food, Agriculture and Commodities Seminar, Illinois, USA, the North America Productivity Workshop, Miami, USA, and the European Workshop on Efficiency and Productivity Analysis, Faro, Portugal, and we thank participants for their helpful suggestions.
abstract_zh: 我们感谢精准保护管理（PCM）项目慷慨提供我们研究所需的数据。感谢刘易斯与克拉克学院经济学系的Moriah Bostian教授、伊利诺伊大学农业与消费经济学系的Scott Irwin教授、马里兰大学农业与资源经济学系的Erik Lichtenberg教授以及慕尼黑工业大学农业生产与资源经济学系的Maria Vrachioli博士提出的宝贵意见。我们感谢伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校期货与期权研究办公室（OFOR）的支持。我们感激编辑Christian Langpap博士及三位匿名审稿人提出的建设性反馈，这些意见使我们的手稿更加完善。本文的早期版本曾在美国伊利诺伊州的ACE食品、农业与商品研讨会、美国迈阿密的北美生产力研讨会以及葡萄牙法鲁的欧洲效率与生产力分析研讨会上报告，我们感谢与会者的有益建议。
title: What are the carbon services from cover‐crop adoption worth from farmers' perspective?
title_zh: 从农户视角看，覆盖作物采纳的碳服务价值几何？

abstract: The growing prevalence of animal feeding operations (AFOs) in the United States raises concerns among the public and regulators about their impact on local environmental quality. By linking historical regulatory records of AFOs in Iowa to downstream surface water pollution monitors, this paper studies the effects of the 2003 Clean Water Act regulations that targeted water pollution from the largest hog AFOs. The regulation decreased ammonia concentrations downstream of large hog AFOs by 6–8 percentage points. We find limited to no evidence of improvement for dissolved oxygen and phosphorus concentrations. Pollution reductions are largest during heavy precipitation months, consistent with the regulations reducing on-site spills and nutrient runoff from local fields. However, we find that pollution increased downstream from mid-sized hog AFOs, which were exempt from the updated regulations. Given the growth in the number of mid-sized facilities relative to large AFOs, we estimate that the regulation had little discernible impact on overall water quality.
abstract_zh: 美国动物饲养操作（AFOs）日益增多，引起了公众和监管机构对其对当地环境质量影响的担忧。通过将爱荷华州AFOs的历史监管记录与下游地表水污染监测数据相连接，本文研究了2003年《清洁水法》针对最大规模猪类AFOs水污染的规定效果。该规定使大型猪类AFOs下游的氨氮浓度降低了6至8个百分点。我们发现，对于溶解氧和磷浓度的改善证据有限或不存在。污染减少在强降水月份最为显著，这与规定减少了现场泄漏和当地农田养分径流的情况相符。然而，我们发现，在未受新规约束的中型猪类AFOs下游，污染有所增加。鉴于中型设施数量相对于大型AFOs的增长，我们估计该规定对整体水质的影响微乎其微。
title: Size‐based regulation and water quality: Evidence from the Iowa hog industry
title_zh: 基于规模的监管与水质：来自爱荷华州生猪产业的证据

abstract: We evaluate the impact of a large Government of Ethiopia intervention to raise fertilizer supply by establishing five fertilizer blending facilities supplying fertilizers tailored to local soil nutrient profiles. We rely on the phased geographic rollout of blending facility establishment to identify the causal effect on fertilizer use, application rates, crop yields, gross crop revenue, and household consumption. Combining effects of multiple treatment periods, each estimated using a doubly robust difference-in-difference model, we find that the blending facilities increased the probability that farmers adopt the new blended fertilizers by 22 percentage points and increased application rates by 17 kg/ha (baseline adoption was zero). The facilities mostly induced farmers who previously used DAP to switch to NPS, and we find large decreases in DAP adoption (by 22 percentage points, 47% of the control group base mean) and application rates (16 kg/ha, 52% of the control group base mean) yet no impact on overall fertilizer adoption or application rates. Though the new blended fertilizers were expected to perform better, there is no evidence they improved crop yields, crop gross revenue, or household consumption. The effect of the intervention was more pronounced (with larger increases in NPS use and larger decreases in DAP use) for farms located near demonstration plots, which the Government used to train farmers about the agronomic response to the new fertilizers. We confirm results using three large-scale longitudinal datasets and show that they are robust to choices of specification, treatment definition, and inference assumptions.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了埃塞俄比亚政府一项大规模干预措施的影响，该措施通过建立五家肥料混合设施，供应针对当地土壤养分特征定制的肥料，以提高肥料供应。我们利用混合设施建立的分阶段地理推广来识别其对肥料使用、施用量、作物产量、作物毛收入及家庭消费的因果效应。结合多个处理期的效应，每个处理期均采用双重稳健差分中的差分模型进行估计，我们发现这些混合设施使农民采用新型混合肥料的概率提高了22个百分点，施用量增加了17公斤/公顷（基线采用率为零）。这些设施主要促使先前使用DAP的农民转向NPS，我们观察到DAP采用率大幅下降（下降22个百分点，占对照组基期均值的47%）及施用量减少（16公斤/公顷，占对照组基期均值的52%），但对总体肥料采用率或施用量无影响。尽管预期新型混合肥料表现更佳，但没有证据表明它们改善了作物产量、作物毛收入或家庭消费。该干预措施的效果在靠近示范田的农场中更为显著（NPS使用增加更多，DAP使用减少更多），政府利用这些示范田向农民培训新肥料的农艺响应。我们使用三个大规模纵向数据集确认了结果，并表明这些结果对规格选择、处理定义及推断假设具有稳健性。
title: Evaluating large‐scale government investments in fertilizer adoption: The Ethiopian experience
title_zh: 评估大规模政府化肥推广投资：埃塞俄比亚的经验

abstract: Land subsidence threatens the living conditions of about 1.2 billion people worldwide in deltaic regions characterized by soft top soil. Economic activity in these areas requires lowering groundwater levels to keep the land sufficiently dry, which leaves future generations worse off by accelerating subsidence and increasing future costs. This paper provides a model that recognizes this trade-off and yields analytical expressions for the groundwater level paths that optimally manage the dynamics of subsidence in agricultural lands. Applying our model to the paradigm case of Dutch peatlands, we find that accounting for dynamic efficiency increases welfare by more than 2.5% compared to a myopic benchmark, and these gains can be about 10% within reasonable parameter ranges. Our results support current proposals to reduce subsidence, even without considering additional social benefits from avoided carbon dioxide emissions.
abstract_zh: 地面沉降威胁着全球约12亿生活在以软质表层土壤为特征的三角洲地区居民的生活条件。这些地区的经济活动需要降低地下水位以保持土地足够干燥，但这会加速沉降并增加未来成本，从而使后代状况恶化。本文提出一个模型，认识到这一权衡，并为农业用地中沉降动态的最优管理提供了地下水位路径的解析表达式。将我们的模型应用于荷兰泥炭地的典型案例，我们发现，与短视基准相比，考虑动态效率可使福利增加超过2.5%，且在合理参数范围内，这些收益可达约10%。我们的结果支持当前减少沉降的提议，即使不考虑避免二氧化碳排放所带来的额外社会效益也是如此。
title: Sinking peatlands: Optimal control of subsidence
title_zh: 沉陷泥炭地：地面沉降的最优控制

abstract: We propose a novel Bayesian Graded Response Model (BGRM) for measuring household-level food security and other latent traits. The BGRM produces continuous food security estimates along with household-level measures of estimation uncertainty. Unlike the USDA's official model, the BGRM accommodates both binary and ordered polytomous items. We further extend the model to allow for any combination of binary, ordered polytomous, and even continuous variables. To demonstrate the model's features, we estimate the BGRM using responses to the 10 adult core Food Security Module questions from the 2017–2018 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES). Results show non-trivial uncertainty in household-level food security estimates and overlap across USDA-defined food security categories. As a robustness check, we estimate the model with Current Population Survey data, finding qualitatively similar results. We illustrate an application of the continuous food security estimates by calculating Foster, Greer, and Thorbecke indices which capture the prevalence, depth, and severity of food insecurity. To demonstrate flexibility in variable selection, we also include a continuous variable, household-level monthly food spending, capturing both economic access and experiential food security information in a single latent construct. The adaptability of the BGRM positions it as a versatile tool for measuring food security and related latent traits, particularly when measures of uncertainty or a mix of different variable types are required. While the empirical application illustrates model capabilities, the primary contribution of the study is methodological.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的贝叶斯分级响应模型（BGRM），用于衡量家庭层面的粮食安全及其他潜在特质。BGRM能够生成连续的粮食安全估计值，并提供家庭层面的估计不确定性度量。与美国农业部的官方模型不同，BGRM同时适用于二元和有序多分类项目。我们进一步扩展该模型，使其能够处理二元、有序多分类乃至连续变量的任意组合。为展示模型特性，我们利用2017-2018年全国健康与营养调查（NHANES）中10个成人核心粮食安全模块问题的回答来估计BGRM。结果显示，家庭层面粮食安全估计存在显著的不确定性，且美国农业部定义的粮食安全类别之间存在重叠。作为稳健性检验，我们使用当前人口调查数据估计该模型，发现结果在性质上相似。我们通过计算Foster、Greer和Thorbecke指数来展示连续粮食安全估计的应用，这些指数捕捉了粮食不安全的普遍性、深度和严重程度。为展示变量选择的灵活性，我们还将家庭月度食品支出这一连续变量纳入模型，在单一潜在构念中同时捕捉经济获取和体验性粮食安全信息。BGRM的适应性使其成为衡量粮食安全及相关潜在特质的多功能工具，尤其是在需要不确定性度量或混合不同类型变量的情况下。尽管实证应用展示了模型的能力，但本研究的主要贡献在于方法论层面。
title: A flexible model of food security: Estimation and implications for prediction
title_zh: 粮食安全的灵活模型：估计及其对预测的启示

abstract: To explain how some farmers' decisions may diverge from profit-maximization, we incorporate proactive social preferences for public goods in an expected utility framework, in addition to reactive risk preferences to uncertainty. We offer empirical evidence that proactive preferences influence farmers' decisions alongside reactive preferences by combining a discrete choice experiment, a dictator game, and the Eckle Grossman risk elicitation method. In our application, farmers choose between selling to origin-identified (OI) markets, which may provide public goods but involve uncertainty, and to wholesale markets, which offer certainty but do not provide public goods. Farmers are heterogeneous in their valuation of OI markets, but, on average, are willing to accept loss in profit to sell to OI markets. This willingness-to-accept is partially explained by farmers' social preferences, even when controlling for risk preferences. Our results show that when evaluating policies, failure to consider either social or risk preferences leads to considerably different outcomes. To increase sales through OI markets and support the perceived associated public goods, policymakers could leverage farmers' preferences for these markets with carefully designed incentives.
abstract_zh: 为解释部分农户决策为何可能偏离利润最大化目标，我们在期望效用框架中引入了对公共物品的主动性社会偏好，同时纳入对不确定性的反应性风险偏好。通过结合离散选择实验、独裁者博弈以及Eckel-Grossman风险诱导方法，我们提供了实证证据，表明主动性偏好与反应性偏好共同影响农户决策。在我们的应用中，农户需在销售给产地标识（OI）市场与批发市场之间做出选择：前者可能提供公共物品但伴随不确定性，后者则提供确定性但不涉及公共物品。农户对OI市场的估值存在异质性，但平均而言，他们愿意接受利润损失以销售至OI市场。即便在控制风险偏好的情况下，这种接受意愿部分可由农户的社会偏好解释。研究结果表明，在政策评估中，若忽视社会偏好或风险偏好中的任一因素，将导致截然不同的结果。为通过OI市场增加销售并支持其所关联的公共物品，政策制定者可借助精心设计的激励措施，利用农户对这些市场的偏好。
title: Farmers' pro‐social motivations and willingness‐to‐accept in markets with public goods
title_zh: 农民亲社会动机与公共品市场中的接受意愿

abstract: The timing and amount of rainfall are crucial in forage growth. Producer perceptions of the rainfall distribution are likely to influence their choices related to the Pasture, Rangeland, and Forage Rainfall Index insurance program. Because of the scarcity of forage production data, diversity of forage production systems, and climates throughout the United States, the correlation between the timing of rainfall and forage growth varies substantially. Using survey data from the northeastern and southeastern United States, we provide a snapshot of producers' perceptions on the relevant rainfall timing for forage growth. We also show that the perceptions do not align with actual insurance enrollment in the surveyed counties. We provide an empirical framework linking survey responses to county-level observational data using a Bayesian approach to determine the months when rainfall is most important for forage growth. We find that the producers' perceptions act as useful priors and are consistent with the county-level analysis. Our methods demonstrate a framework for combining survey data with secondary data to overcome data constraints that can be applied to other contexts beyond the Pasture, Rangeland, and Forage Rainfall Index insurance program.
abstract_zh: 降雨的时间和数量对牧草生长至关重要。生产者对降雨分布的认知可能影响其与牧场、草地及牧草降雨指数保险计划相关的选择。由于牧草生产数据的稀缺性、美国各地牧草生产系统及气候的多样性，降雨时间与牧草生长之间的相关性存在显著差异。利用美国东北部和东南部的调查数据，我们提供了生产者对牧草生长相关降雨时间认知的概览。同时，我们表明这些认知与所调查县的实际保险参保情况并不一致。我们构建了一个实证框架，通过贝叶斯方法将调查响应与县级观测数据联系起来，以确定降雨对牧草生长最为关键的月份。我们发现，生产者的认知可作为有效的先验信息，并与县级分析结果一致。我们的方法展示了一种将调查数据与二手数据相结合以克服数据限制的框架，该框架可应用于牧场、草地及牧草降雨指数保险计划之外的其他情境。
title: Rainfall timing, forage growth, and insuring forage: Linking producer perceptions to observational data
title_zh: 降雨时机、牧草生长与牧草保险：将生产者认知与观测数据相联系

abstract: Both the rate and timing of crop fertilizer application play an important role in agricultural productivity. However, inefficient fertilizer use can significantly increase production costs, water pollution, and greenhouse gas emissions. To capture both the spatial heterogeneity and dynamic nature of this problem, we develop a multi-stage network production model, which links the sequential stages of crop growth within the overall crop production process. We use this framework to estimate nitrogen fertilizer application inefficiency and to determine the optimal rate and timing of fertilizer application. We apply this framework to wheat production at the field scale, using an agronomic simulation model calibrated to experimental data from Australia. Our results indicate that it is optimal to reduce the overall fertilizer application rate and to move away from the current practice of front-loading fertilizer in the initial stages of crop growth toward the intermediate stages. This can be achieved without compromising yields while also reducing nutrient losses.
abstract_zh: 作物施肥的速率与时机对农业生产率均具有重要影响。然而，低效的施肥使用可能显著增加生产成本、水污染及温室气体排放。为捕捉该问题的空间异质性与动态特性，我们构建了一个多阶段网络生产模型，该模型将作物生长过程中的连续阶段与整体作物生产过程相衔接。我们利用此框架评估氮肥施用效率，并确定施肥的最优速率与时机。我们将该框架应用于田间尺度的小麦生产，采用基于澳大利亚实验数据校准的农艺模拟模型。结果表明，最优策略是降低总体施肥速率，并摒弃当前在作物生长初期集中施肥的做法，转而将施肥重点移至生长中期阶段。这一调整可在不牺牲产量的同时减少养分损失。
title: Optimal timing and rate of nitrogen fertilizer use: An integrated network technology approach
title_zh: 氮肥施用的最优时机与施用量：一种集成网络技术方法

abstract: In a recent paper, Lin and Palfrey (2024) developed a theory of cognitive hierarchies (CH) in sequential games and observed that this solution concept is not reduced-normal-form invariant. In this paper I qualify and explain this observation. I show that the CH model is normal-form invariant, and that the differences arising from the application of the CH model to the reduced normal form depend only on how randomization by level-0 types is modeled. Indeed, while the uniform behavior strategy in the extensive form yields the uniform mixed strategy in the normal form, the latter does not correspond to the uniform randomization in the reduced normal form, because different reduced strategies may correspond to sets of equivalent strategies with different cardinalities. I also comment on (i) the invariance of the CH model to some transformations of the sequential game, and (ii) the independence of conditional beliefs about co-players’ level-types.
abstract_zh: 在近期的一篇论文中，Lin和Palfrey（2024）提出了序贯博弈中的认知层级（CH）理论，并观察到该解概念不具备约简正规型不变性。本文对这一观察进行了限定与解释。我证明CH模型具有正规型不变性，且将CH模型应用于约简正规型时产生的差异仅取决于对0层级类型随机化的建模方式。实际上，尽管扩展型中的均匀行为策略对应于正规型中的均匀混合策略，但后者并不对应于约简正规型中的均匀随机化，因为不同的约简策略可能对应于基数不同的等价策略集合。我还就以下两点进行了评论：（i）CH模型对序贯博弈某些变换的不变性，以及（ii）关于对手层级类型的条件信念的独立性。
title: Reduced strategies and cognitive hierarchies in the extensive and normal form
title_zh: 简化策略与认知层级在扩展式与标准式博弈中的表现
